architecturalPlan.scaleRationale: The US$25m figure is treated as a marker of exceptional architectural ambition, not a construction budget or area formula. The estate is sized as a 776 m² single-level composition: a 392 m² central entertaining pavilion and two 192 m² suite pavilions, providing capacity for six generous suites while retaining broad outdoor rooms. The supplied waterfront setting supports a low, view-oriented campus rather than a tall object. Site dimensions, exact shoreline, survey, setbacks, wind and flood levels are unprovided assumptions.
architecturalPlan.arrivalAndCirculation: All occupied slabs have a 0.20 m walking datum above the temporary flat ground plane. A landward driveway arrives directly at the central pavilion's protected front entrance, main-living-glass-2. The suite pavilions have separate covered front entrances, suite-west-glass-1 and suite-east-glass-1, reached by the shared arrival court and dry exterior circulation. The pool terrace is entered through the real rear garden opening main-rear-garden-panel. No upper occupied level is proposed, avoiding unresolved stair access.
architecturalPlan.volumeHierarchy: A 28 x 14 m, 4.20 m-high central living pavilion is the dominant datum. Two lower 12 x 16 m, 3.40 m-high private pavilions sit with 3 m clear lateral separation from the main pavilion's roof edges. The living roof ridge rises 1.20 m above its eaves; the suite roofs rise 1.00 m. A 14 x 2.4 m supported pool-terrace canopy marks the transition from enclosed living to the water.
architecturalPlan.relationshipsAndViews: The arrival sequence is organized on the +Z side of the central pavilion; the ocean-facing outdoor sequence extends through the rear garden door, shaded terrace, pool near deck and rectangular basin toward -Z. The two suite pavilions frame this shared outdoor room without crossing the pool footprint. The pool's far edge is composed as the view edge, but no shoreline, actual ocean water, horizon, hydraulic overflow, or surveyed slope is represented.
architecturalPlan.roofFacadeAndMaterials: The composition uses pale limestone envelopes, warm timber roof and canopy planes, and bronze-toned frames/screens implied by the selected palette. Broad hip and gable roofs with deep 0.9–1.4 m eaves provide a Caribbean climate response. Front facade bays establish a formal arrival rhythm; the pool facade is replaced with a deep, real garden-door opening and flanking limestone piers. Suite rears receive wide but fixed glazed view bays, while their actual entries remain on the arrival side.

name: Azure Courtyard Estate
summary: A complete editable exterior estate composition with a commanding central living pavilion, two six-suite-capacity private pavilions, a formal arrival drive, supported pool terrace and fully constructed rectangular pool basin.
unsupported: The requested gently sloping Saint Lucia site is represented on the mandated flat Y=0 ground plane; no terrain slope, retaining, drainage, shore or flood design is modeled.
Interior partitions, six individual suite layouts, bathrooms, kitchens, furniture, services and detailed internal circulation remain unfinished by exterior scope.
Tropical planting is reserved by editable planting-bed plates only; trees, palms, planting geometry, irrigation and ecological landscape design are unbuilt.

The pool is a complete editable rectangular basin and dry circuit, but not a hydraulically modeled infinity pool; no overflow trough, pumps, filtration, safety engineering or ocean connection is represented.
Structural engineering, hurricane/corrosion performance, code compliance, local planning setbacks and waterfront approvals are not verified.

scene.name: Azure Courtyard Estate
scene.generationBrief:
Design and construct an extraordinary contemporary Caribbean waterfront estate in Saint Lucia with an estimated property value of US$25 million.

The property occupies a spacious waterfront site with ocean views and a gently sloping landscape.

Create a sophisticated luxury residence with approximately six generous bedroom suites, expansive living and entertainment spaces, a memorable entrance, exceptional indoor-outdoor connections, substantial terraces, a spectacular infinity pool and integrated tropical landscaping.

Develop a coherent architectural concept with impressive massing, coordinated building volumes, beautiful proportions, interesting elevations, sophisticated materials and an unmistakable luxury-estate presence.

You have creative freedom over the building composition, number of levels, architectural style, roof forms and overall arrangement.

Construct the complete, editable 3D exterior architecture rather than a small conceptual representation.
